description: This file implements the ExtendedResourcesManager class for managing GPU resources, shader compilation, and extended resource modes on UWP platform, specifically for Xbox devices. It handles acquiring and releasing GPU resources, compiling shaders asynchronously, and managing device and queue objects.

classes.name: ExtendedResourcesManager
classes.description: Manages GPU extended resources, shader compilation, and device objects for UWP Xbox platform.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main loop for acquiring and releasing extended GPU resources, compiling shaders, and handling events.

methods.name: AcquireExtendedResources
methods.description: Requests acquisition of extended GPU resources from another thread.

methods.name: ReleaseExtendedResources
methods.description: Requests release of extended GPU resources from another thread.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Signals the manager to quit its main loop.

methods.name: GetD3D12Objects
methods.description: Retrieves D3D12 device, heap, and command queue objects if resources are available.

methods.name: StartCompileShaders
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous shader compilation for decoders.

methods.name: CompileShadersAsynchronously
methods.description: Performs shader compilation in a background task.

methods.name: ReleaseExtendedResourcesInternal
methods.description: Releases GPU resources, shaders, and resets device objects, handling cleanup and failure states.
